competing_explanation: The claim may be based on an outdated policy, a misreading of the policy, or confusion between standard items and special or final-sale items.
hypothesis_statement: The current policy provides a 30-day full-refund return window for standard items.
refutation_criterion: If the current authoritative policy states a different return window for standard items, excludes standard items from full refunds, or specifies that full refunds are not available within 30 days.
